## Requirements (contract § In scope)

1. **Deterministic scanner.** `evidence/screen.py` (pure
   `screen_blob` → `{class_id: hit_count}`) + the committed
   `sig.at-rest-audit-decl/1` (`ops/at_rest_audit.toml`) +
   `ops/src/ops/at_rest_audit.py` + `sig-ops at-rest scan|seal-plan|
   seal-apply|seal-verify`: F-406 classes (OSM `user`/`uid`,
   Eyes-on-Flock `summary.top_search_reasons` free text, all-attribute
   ArcGIS), I7 S1–S9 lane screens (member-glob scoped), SIG-PUB-002
   categories on every capture. Field-name/pattern rules only; no model
   judgment is presented as a human check.
2. **Counts-only report.** `sig.at-rest-audit/1`: objects listed/scanned/
   unreadable, per-class × per-source hit counts, PUB-002 category counts
   — never values, excerpts or samples. Object ids/digests only in the
   restricted `sig.at-rest-flagged/1` sidecar (marked restricted; never
   the public repo).
3. **Seal or suppress, append-only (SIG-GOV-007).** Flagged captures
   leave every publishable tier and stay retained under `sealed`:
   append-only `capture_seal` rows (decision, author, rule ids, the L1
   report ref) + `withhold` publication dispositions + a versioned
   `sig.seal-deny/1` deny set — the ticket-chosen mechanism (the
   contract's "sealed-digest deny set … that every export, the API
   evidence paths and the release builder consult" + the appended
   new-table seal register). No UPDATE/DELETE anywhere; no byte deleted,
   moved by delete, or overwritten; `capture_currently_sealed` gives
   latest-action semantics (a superseding `unseal` restores).
4. **Lists for the operator.** The counts-only `sig.pub002-listing/1`
   holds the PUB-002 categorical counts for the operator's purge decision
   once P37.71's purge function exists (WV-11; ADR-181/189) — nothing is
   purged here.
5. **Owed rows routed.** `D-P34.49-1` (P37.3 copies) + `D-P34.49-2`
   (capture-writer `user`/`uid`; trigger: the next OSM replay fire) —
   DEFERRALS rows + `e0` anchors.

## Boundaries

**No production mutation ran or runs in this row.** L1 (the read-only
scan) queues exit 42 until the P34.43 exec host exists and the window
opens (≥ 2026-10-13T12:00Z excl. 03:00–06:30Z); L2 additionally queues on
L1's recorded counts, an AR-2 SUCCESSFUL backup, `SIG_ATREST_AUTHOR`, and
the hosted `seal_register` deploy (P34.46's plan advance). The verbatim
re-run line — `implement-spec
spec=docs/tickets/254_P34.49__part-viii-at-rest-audit.md
live_verification=true` (scope: the named leg) — is printed by every
guard. Sealing is suppression only: append-only `capture_seal` rows +
`withhold` dispositions + a new deny-set object version; **no byte is
deleted, moved by delete, or overwritten**; rollback is a superseding
`unseal` row + a prior-entries deny-set version. True purge stays the
operator's WV-11 action (ADR-181/189), never this row. No
`ingestion_permitted` flip, no `HG-nn` gate ticked, no human/rights/
publication claim fabricated.

## Deviations

- **OM-16 size:** ~3,815 changed lines excl. generated files and fixtures
  (~3,944 total incl. generated) — over the 3,000 M budget. The ticket
  bundles three halves (the screen+scanner, the seal register + two
  consults, the windowed leg + records); a split would have separated
  the migration+serving half from the scanner/leg half. Recorded, not
  hidden — no false in-budget claim.
- **RETURN PASS carry-forward:** the mid-run staged state added the
  `P34.49` return-pass row + `returnPass:` id ahead of the ticket's PHASE
  LOG/BUILD_INDEX entries — the same landed-set divergence P34.42a hit
  at `bb19050f` (`ledger_contract` counts returnPass membership →
  `next-not-lowest` wanted P34.44a; the row also pushed the orient
  recipe >48 KiB). Rows are keyed by the landed ticket (B3 §3.13), so
  the row + region + `nextTicket` advance belong in the post-green
  record commit — `return_pass.toml` restored byte-identical to the base
  tip, the region regenerated (26 rows · 25 ids), `docs-check` green.
- **Earlier-heads fix series (recorded, fix-forward):** screen-decl
  `Rule`-vs-tuple test fix; deny-set digest full-id expectation; the
  GCP apply test's missing `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` (the GL-GATE-04 refusal
